# Opulanz

> Luxembourg-based European financial and business platform (brand of Groupe Advensys Luxembourg S.A., RCS B197138).

Opulanz is not a credit institution or electronic money institution and does not hold client funds. Regulated intermediation is provided by Advensys Insurance-Finance SARL (ORIAS no. 21003660).
